theorems.name_zh: 质量耦合与作用类质量相等
theorems.assumptions: Fixed source/target ports; positive finite masses; all-safe-lattice germ relation
theorems.statement: Weighted row equality iff a nonnegative coupling has exact original marginals and support on equivalent action pairs.

theorems.name_zh: 森林支持的完整共同提升
theorems.assumptions: Fixed seed, global guard and next precision digit; complete support enumeration
theorems.statement: A union of simultaneous existing lift systems over feasible forest coupling supports covers all next-digit weighted transporters.

theorems.name_zh: 单层加权修复纤维仿射性
theorems.assumptions: Prime residue field; projective congruence kernel at N>=1; fixed lower seed; conjugation-invariant germ universe
theorems.statement: The complete next-digit transporter fibre is empty or an affine F_p-space. Affine hull of certified fragments is sound; exhaustive fragments make it complete.

theorems.name_zh: 更换对应可挽救固定对应无解
theorems.assumptions: Declared equal-mass A,B and low frame; repeated block frame scope when counted
theorems.statement: Identity correspondence has zero lifts while swapped correspondence gives eight; unequal weights destroy this rescue.

theorems.name_zh: 作用类分裂的全匹配质量障碍
theorems.assumptions: U,UE_k,V with masses1/4,1/4,1/2; p=2; original shallow exchange frame class
theorems.statement: Exchange works at m<=k; at m>k no frame in that shallow class can satisfy the complete weighted law, including full6x6 frames.

theorems.name_zh: 证书与可达首达观察失效层不同
theorems.assumptions: Fixed declared stopped BRC model and standard initial lattice
theorems.statement: At R=3 full safe-germ exchange certificate fails but the complete first-passage kernels remain equal; at R=4 risks differ and first time-law difference occurs at tick8.
